title: Start of the Account History Weighed by a TRICARE Prime Draft
content:
The account history a draft through the payment method on file of a fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment weighs runs from a starting month:

- where the enrollment was brought back by an Enrollment Reinstatement Review decided overturned - a case of Appeals and Grievances whose subject is the enrollment - the month after the old paid-through date the review recorded;
- where the enrollment took effect in the plan year in which the history ends, the month containing its effective date;
- otherwise the first month of the plan year in which the history ends.

## Hypothetical starting months (monthly arrangement, today in October, so the history ends in September)

| Records | Starting month |
|---|---|
| Review decided overturned; old paid-through date 30 April | May |
| No such review; effective date 12 June of this year | June |
| No such review; effective in an earlier year | January of this year |
